findings.finding: Every failed step returns to a fixed three-second outer interval. There is no failure-specific exponential backoff, due-time or terminal quarantine. This is not a zero-delay busy loop.
findings.effect: A permanently invalid or irreducible source can repeatedly consume model work whenever the foreground is idle.

findings.finding: fail_compaction releases source reservations, and prepare_compaction fairly orders by attempt count. This prevents one rejected group from permanently starving unrelated groups, but still retries every failed group indefinitely.
findings.effect: Retries preserve all uncommitted bodies; disabling or backing off retry must not fabricate successful compaction or delete those bodies.

findings.finding: ValueError/CandidateRejected become candidate_rejected; MemoryBusy becomes database_busy; TimeoutError and InterruptedError currently fall through to model_failed.
findings.effect: discarded is not a count of malformed summaries alone. Cancellation, timeout, stale lease and inference failures cannot be distinguished from the existing aggregate counters. A stale commit increments discarded without updating last error.

findings.finding: Factory uses worker defaults interval=3, max_events=2 and summary defaults per-call=30s, max_calls=256, total_budget=900s. Silent wake listening is explicitly allowed to coexist with summary work; speech onset, pending foreground, playback or unsafe clock disallows it.
findings.effect: An active summary during WAITING_WAKE is expected. The cancellation predicate and summary watcher must remain intact.

findings.finding: The model host rejects new summary admission while foreground exists, cancels queued/active summary when dialogue/TTS arrives, and schedules foreground before summaries.
findings.effect: A diagnostic probe requiring an idle host can be blocked by repeated summary work; that alone does not prove ordinary submitted dialogue cannot preempt it.

minimal_next_step: Read only the exact whitelisted last error plus counter deltas and task-attempt counts, without raw text or IDs. If policy change is authorized, implement it as a new separately frozen candidate: bounded failure backoff and accurate cancellation/timeout classification, preserving foreground preemption, fair retry, all source bodies and the atomic summary-before-delete contract.

synthetic_reproduction.proved: Four consecutive attempts re-lease the same failed group and increment attempts to four, while retaining its body and creating no summary; non-idle foreground prevents summarize calls.
